description: What the Pennsylvania DHS Medicheck Precluded Providers data covers and how current it is: total rows ever recorded, how many are currently precluded vs. ended vs. status-unknown, how many carry an NPI, license number, or FEIN, the distinct status values DHS uses, and the oldest/newest preclusion effective dates. Use to check the screening data is fresh enough to rely on before a compliance decision, and to see the one-line notes on the status field's gaps and the ever-vs-currently-precluded distinction. Pass year (e.g. 2025) or start_date/end_date to instead COUNT how many preclusions have an effective date in that year or range, counted over the whole 6,700+ row list, not a page — answers "how many PA Medicheck preclusions took effect in 2025". The response names the date field counted (begin_date / DHS's BeginDate — never list_date, which answers a different question and gives a different number). Sourced from the Pennsylvania DHS Medicheck Precluded Providers List, keyless.
name: pa_medical_exclusion_coverage
